content:
maya: Hey — running into a weird CI failure on the quickstart sample. Locally `curl` with my personal key succeeds, but in CI the service account token we mint via OIDC returns 403 (payment_required).
lucas_dev: can you paste the exact curl and the CI log snippet?
maya: sure — local curl that works:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $PERSONAL_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/generate -d '{"model":"gpt-redwood-1","input":"hi"}'
# 200 OK
```
CI using service token:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $SERVICE_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/generate -d '{"model":"gpt-redwood-1","input":"hi"}'
# HTTP/1.1 403
# {"error":"payment_required","message":"workspace billing consent required for service tokens"}
```
maya: this started happening after we switched to OIDC short-lived tokens last week — we didn't change billing settings.
olivia_support: That response is our paygate kicking in. We recently tightened checks so service tokens used for non-interactive CI require workspace billing consent / a billing contact. Personal keys (user-scoped) still bypass that check if the user has a card on file.
lucas_dev: Is this a bug in the quickstart docs? The sample repo still shows service-account flow without mentioning billing consent.
sam_eng: That's on us — we rolled the backend change but didn't update the quickstart docs/notes about org billing consent for service tokens. Apologies.
maya: Any short-term workaround? We need green CI for a demo tomorrow.
olivia_support: temporary options: 1) add a billing contact/card to the workspace (recommended), 2) use a personal API key as a CI secret (less ideal but works), or 3) DM me your tenant id and I can request a 1-hour whitelist while you update billing settings. I can also escalate to try to speed it up.
lucas_dev: also seeing noise in our CI logs — our Python SDK retries the call a few times which floods logs with 403s and hides the root cause. Looks like retry policy is treating 4xx as retryable in our pinned SDK version.
sam_eng: Good call. The SDK default retry policy accidentally considered network errors and some 4xx as retryable prior to v1.2.0. We're pushing a patch to stop retrying on 4xx client errors (especially 401/403/422). Will also add clearer error text when paygate triggers.
maya: thanks. For transparency — here's the relevant SDK snippet that keeps retrying:
```python
# quickstart sample snippet
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(token=os.environ['SERVICE_TOKEN'])
resp = client.chat.completions.create(model='gpt-redwood-1', input='hello')
# library retried 3x then raised 403 after backoff
```
sam_eng: We're gating the fix behind a canary deploy. devex-bot will post when it's live.
devex-bot: deploy queued: sdk/retry-fix -> canary (sha: abc123).
maya: For now we'll swap to a personal key in CI and I'll update the repo README to call out the billing step for service accounts.
olivia_support: I'll DM next steps and the onboarding checklist (billing contact, org admin flow). If you want I can open a support ticket to track adding billing consent permanently.
maya: Great, thanks everyone :pray:
